# software-rasterizer

> Rasterize triangles on the CPU with a top-left fill rule, z-buffer, perspective-correct texturing, Lambert lighting, OBJ loading and tolerance-based image comparison C++20 library `software-rasterizer`, namespace `trysac::software_rasterizer`, CMake target
> `trysac::software_rasterizer`, MIT licensed, standard library only.
